_doc: A bottle of the game's own booze (#1222, docs/briefs/booze.md): a heavy dark-green wine bottle (champagne or claret), a punt, its cork under gilt foil. Its labels the brands of its shape (Veuve Morandiere, Chateau Larcenac): the Nth made wears label N mod 2 (`variants`), or the one its dressing entry names (`variant`; tools/props/booze.py variant_of). A prop that shatters (GlassProp): a fall onto boards at 5.0 m/s or 70 kPa breaks it and what's in it goes on the floor. Drawn from glb:booze_bottles (tools/blender/props/booze.py): the glass the kit's `glass:` look, every label printed on one sheet (pbr:booze_labels), cork and contents baked the gun way. Written by tools/props/booze.py.
